evidence.reason: The dependency scanner is intended to discover any [Unit] dependency linking another unit to a selected CRQ unit, but DEPENDENCY_RE omits systemd's stop-propagation directives StopPropagatedFrom= and PropagatesStopTo=. A co-installed unit with StopPropagatedFrom=crq-tick.service is therefore not detected, so stopping the fence unit can propagate a stop to that co-tenant. Adding both directives to the existing dependency regex is the smallest fix and does not add a new protection scope; it completes the scanner's existing dependency coverage.
